{{Wireless adapter |brand=Samsung |model=SWL-1000N |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=08/12/1998 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=PCMCIA (16-bit) |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=E2XSWL-1000N |ic_id= |chip1_brand=AMD |chip1_model=Am79C930 |chip2_brand=Harris |chip2_model=HSP3824 |chip3_brand=Harris |chip3_model=HFA3724 |flags=schematics |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=legacy (DSSS) |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device was sold by '''Nokia''' as the C021. :[http://www.qsl.net/n9zia/wireless/appendixG.html 802.11 Wireless LAN Cards] (internal images of the C021) :The device in photos uses HFA3726.
Per a CII PC made 05/21/1999, '''Samsung''' swapped the HFA3724 to HFA3726, but the letter states.. :... '''these components are identical in their internal circuitry. It is more or less a nomenclature change.''' .. the mixer was also changed from a HFA3624 to an AT32032.
